note: Authority Twitter/X posts — summarized with link. Verify on original tweet; not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted an update on flash floods in the Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, reporting 538 bodies recovered so far along with 632 people from 33 countries (121 found, 511 missing) and ongoing search-and-rescue efforts. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice establishing an Emergency Control Room (ECR) for foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood in Rasuwa, with hotlines/WhatsApp +977-9744441227 and +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm), email emergency@mofa.gov.np, and updates at mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/. This announcement does not constitute independent confirmation of events.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia announced a Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation and listed contact options for families of Indian nationals (+91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, situationroom@mea.gov.in). This tweet does not constitute official confirmation of events.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal posted that rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi / Rasuwa flash flood are published on the NDRRMA rescue portal and SETU platform. It directs families to official channels at ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue and setu.ndrrma.gov.np.

items.title: Nepal Police HQ
items.summary: @NepalPoliceHQ states that Nepal Police Unified Database (UDB) publishes official found, missing, and unidentified remains lists for flood-affected areas at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np and advises against relying on unofficial social media posts.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal states that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in the Rasuwa/Bhotekoshi area and directs people to contact the MEA control room or the Embassy for assistance.
